items.text: The design shows two replicas but does not define traffic behaviour when one application instance is unavailable.
The Solution Intent does not define recovery time or recovery point objectives.
The production support team and escalation path have not been assigned.
Update the resilience design and deployment diagram; Alex Chen agreed to complete this by 2026-07-24.
Confirm the RTO and RPO values; Priya Shah agreed to complete this by 2026-07-25.
